title: My Face on the Astronaut
tests: Tests recognizable source identity, natural face blending and preservation of the supplied poster.

faults.what: The swapped face looks slightly elongated and smoothed compared with the woman's portrait.

judge.summary: The woman's recognizable face fits cleanly inside the astronaut helmet, with the original poster preserved, though her facial proportions look slightly elongated.

must_haves.item: The astronaut's face is recognizably the woman from portrait-woman.jpg.
must_haves.why: The eyes, eyebrows, nose and mouth retain a recognizable resemblance to the woman.

must_haves.item: The replacement face fits inside the open helmet without conspicuous seams or doubled features.
must_haves.why: The face sits within the helmet opening with clean edges and no conspicuous seams or duplicated features.

must_haves.item: The original white suit, helmet and star background remain intact.
must_haves.why: The suit details, helmet structure and surrounding star field appear unchanged.

must_haves.item: The result retains the retro poster look and vertical composition.
must_haves.why: The tall framing, cream border, aged texture and original poster styling are preserved.
